title: Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026: What's New at Cal Expo
summary: Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026 runs Nov 4-5 at Cal Expo. What's new, the Craft Sungrown Showcase, Tactical Talks schedule, and how retailers attend free.
body_markdown:
Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026 runs November 4 and 5 at Cal Expo, 1600 Exposition Boulevard, from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. both days. It is the first Hall of Flowers ever held in Sacramento, ending an eight-year run at the Sonoma County Fairgrounds in Santa Rosa. Licensed retail buyers attend free.


**This guide covers what changed for 2026, the new programming worth planning around, how retailers get a free badge, and how to work both days so the trip pays for itself.**

## Key Takeaways


- Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026 takes place November 4 and 5 at Cal Expo in Sacramento, its first show at the venue and its first in Sacramento after eight years in Santa Rosa.
- Licensed California retail buyers attend free, subject to a vetting process that requires an active retail license.
- A new outdoor Craft Sungrown Showcase gives 16 small-batch, sun-grown farms a dedicated stage, including Briceland Forest Farm, HappyDay Farms, Henry's Original, and Talking Trees.
- Tactical Talks, a new six-session series produced with Budist, covers trade credit, price compression, and private label. Every session is free with a show badge.
- Day 1 is business-to-business. Day 2 opens to ticketed consumers for a festival format with direct-to-consumer sales from exhibitor booths.


---


## What's New at Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026


The biggest change is the address. After eight years at the Sonoma County Fairgrounds, Hall of Flowers has moved its Northern California show to Cal Expo in Sacramento, and November 4 and 5 will be the first time the show has ever run in the state capital.


Co-founder Rama Mayo pointed to access as the reason, citing proximity to Sacramento International Airport and the show's position in the capital. For buyers driving in from the Central Valley, the Sierra foothills, or Southern California, Sacramento sits at the intersection of I-5 and I-80 instead of an hour northwest of it. Hotel inventory is deeper and cheaper than Sonoma County in harvest season.


The move was not universally welcomed. Sonoma County Tourism president and CEO Claudia Vecchio told the Press Democrat that losing the show is a loss for the county, which had built cannabis into its visitor strategy. Hall of Flowers put Santa Rosa on the map as a cannabis destination for eight years, and that history is part of why the move got as much attention as it did.


Cal Expo also solves a practical problem the Sonoma fairgrounds had started to run into. It is a 350-acre site with substantially more indoor and outdoor space, which is what makes the rest of this year's additions possible: a dedicated outdoor showcase, a session track, and a hiring floor all running alongside the main exhibit hall.


---


## Craft Sungrown Takes the Outdoor Stage


Hall of Flowers is adding a dedicated outdoor Craft Sungrown Showcase for the first time in 2026, built specifically for California's small-batch, sun-grown cultivators. Putting it outdoors is the point. These are farms whose product is defined by growing conditions, and the showcase gives them a setting that matches how they grow instead of a booth under exhibit-hall lighting.


Sixteen farms are participating: Briceland Forest Farm, Down OM Farm, Emerald Spirit Botanicals, Emerald Triangle Craft, Farm Cut, Garcia Hand Picked, Gold Standard, HappyDay Farms, Henry's Original, Mendocino Natural Farms, POET, Rootimentrees, Talking Trees, Trinity Roots, Whitethorn Valley Farm, and Woods Goods.


Actor Woody Harrelson, who co-owns The Woods dispensary, framed the case for the category in the show's announcement:


> **The three most important factors for good herb are sun, soil, and water.**
>
>
> ***Woody Harrelson, co-owner, The Woods***


For retail buyers, this is the most efficient hour at the show. Craft sungrown is a category that is difficult to source at scale and difficult to evaluate from a line sheet. Having 16 vetted farms in one outdoor footprint means you can compare them side by side, meet the people who grew the product, and leave with a shortlist instead of a stack of business cards.


---


## Tactical Talks: Six Sessions, Free With Your Badge


Tactical Talks is a new six-session series produced by Hall of Flowers and Budist, and every session is free with a Hall of Flowers badge. The sessions run at noon, 1 p.m., and 2 p.m. on both days, and the topics are the operational problems buyers and brands argue about privately: who is extending credit to whom, what discounting is doing to margins, and whether building your own brand is worth it.


Two of these are worth rearranging your floor time for if you run a dispensary. "Show Me The Money" is a trade credit conversation with a retailer and a lender on the same stage, which is rare. "The Race to the Bottom" puts a retailer and a brand executive together on discounting, and whichever side of that invoice you sit on, the other side's math is useful to hear out loud.

## Day 2 Opens to the Public


Day 1 of Hall of Flowers Sacramento is business to business, and Day 2 opens to ticketed consumers 21 and over for a festival format with live entertainment, food, the Iconoclasts speaker series, and direct-to-consumer sales from exhibitor booths. Hall of Flowers first ran this hybrid format at its 2024 Santa Rosa show and has carried it forward since.


The organizers are promoting a world record attempt for the most cannabis sales in one place. Treat that as an attempt rather than a result, but the underlying shift is real: exhibiting brands now have a second day to sell through directly instead of relying entirely on Day 1 wholesale conversations to justify the booth. Brands that exhibit also receive an allotment of consumer tickets to hand to their own followers.


For retail buyers, Day 2 is a research day disguised as a party. You will watch several thousand consumers choose between the exact brands sitting on your buy list, in real time, with their own money. That is a cleaner read on sell-through potential than any line sheet or rep conversation, and it is the one thing you cannot get from a Day 1 appointment.


---


## Hall of Careers Brings Hiring to the Show Floor


Hall of Careers runs on the Hall of Flowers floor both days, co-hosted by Shelf Alchemy, and puts cannabis employers and candidates in the same room for scheduled interviews. Candidates and employers register separately in advance.


Staffing is a standing problem in California retail, and most dispensary hiring still happens through job boards that surface applicants with no industry context. A floor where candidates have already self-selected into cannabis is a different pool. If you are carrying open budtender, inventory, or delivery driver roles into the holidays, registering as an employer costs you a form and some floor time you are already spending at the show.


---


## How Retailers Get In Free


Licensed California retail buyers attend Hall of Flowers at no cost, subject to a vetting process. Applications go through the retailer page at hallofflowers.com, and approval requires an active retail license. Operators who have not opened yet can still apply, but Hall of Flowers requires a building permit for a storefront plus city approval in place of an active license.


A few logistics worth putting on the calendar now:


- **Badge pickup starts the night before.** Hall of Flowers takes over Coin-Op Sacramento on November 3 from 6 to 9 p.m. for early badge pickup, pizza, and free arcade play.
- **Hotels are listed on the show site.** Hall of Flowers maintains a Sacramento hotel page, and Cal Expo sits about ten minutes from downtown.
- **Consumer tickets are separate.** Day 2 public tickets are sold through the show's Sacramento ticket page, independent of the retailer application.


---


## How to Work Both Days


Plan the two days as two different jobs, because they are. Day 1 is for appointments, pricing conversations, and the sessions. Day 2 is for watching consumers interact with the brands you are evaluating and for closing on anything you were undecided about after Day 1.


A practical approach that works for buyers who come back with real orders instead of a tote bag:


- **Build the list before you arrive.** Pull your bottom-performing categories from the last 90 days and walk in knowing which three shelves you are actually shopping for.
- **Give the Craft Sungrown Showcase a dedicated block.** It is outdoors and separate from the main hall, which means it gets skipped by people working the floor linearly.
- **Write terms down at the booth.** Trade credit, deal structure, and minimums get renegotiated by memory three weeks later if nobody recorded them.


Then there is the part nobody plans for. You come back from a two-day show with a dozen new SKUs you committed to, each one needing a vendor record, a Metrc transfer, a margin target, and a spot in the menu before it can sell. That intake work is where a good buying trip quietly turns into three weeks of catch-up, and it is the reason strong sourcing decisions sometimes never show up in the P&L.

## Common Questions


### When and where is Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026?


Hall of Flowers Sacramento 2026 takes place November 4 and 5, 2026, at Cal Expo, 1600 Exposition Boulevard, Sacramento, CA 95815. Show hours are 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. both days. This is the show's first year at Cal Expo and its first in Sacramento.


### Is Hall of Flowers free for licensed retailers?


Yes. Licensed retail buyers receive complimentary badges, subject to a vetting process. Approval requires an active retail license, or a storefront building permit plus city approval for operators who have not opened yet. Apply through the retailer page at hallofflowers.com.


### Is Hall of Flowers open to the public?


Day 2 is. November 4 is a business-to-business day for licensed industry. November 5 opens to ticketed consumers 21 and over for a festival format with direct-to-consumer sales, live entertainment, and the Iconoclasts speaker series. Day 2 consumer tickets are sold separately through the show's Sacramento ticket page.


### Why did Hall of Flowers move from Santa Rosa to Sacramento?


Co-founder Rama Mayo cited accessibility, pointing to Sacramento International Airport and the show's position in the state capital. Cal Expo also offers more indoor and outdoor space than the Sonoma County Fairgrounds, which is what accommodates the new outdoor Craft Sungrown Showcase alongside the main exhibit hall.


### Do I need a separate ticket for Tactical Talks?


No. All six Tactical Talks sessions are free with a Hall of Flowers badge, including the complimentary retailer badge. Sessions run at noon, 1 p.m., and 2 p.m. on both November 4 and November 5.


### Can brands sell directly from their booth at Hall of Flowers?


Yes, on Day 2. Exhibiting brands can run direct-to-consumer sales from their booths during the November 5 festival day, which Hall of Flowers supports through an app-driven shopping experience. All sales must run through a licensed retailer, which is why in-booth activations are structured with a retail license partner.
